data.name: Yokai Batting Game in Kawagoe おまつりようかいバッティングゲーム in KAWAGOE
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Smash yokai. Save Kawagoe. All with just one button.

Yokai Batting Game is a fast-paced casual action game set on the lantern-lit festival streets of Kawagoe.
On the night of a full moon, mischievous yokai flood the town—it's up to you to knock them all away and restore peace!

Armed with only a baseball bat, you'll swing, time, and smash your way through waves of yokai using simple one-button controls. Easy to learn, hard to master, and fun for players of all ages.

Step into a vibrant Japanese festival night and see how long you can survive!

FEATURES

  • ⚾ One-Button Action
    Simple controls anyone can play—just time your swing!

  • 👻 Endless Waves of Yokai
    Cute but chaotic yokai will keep coming. Stay focused!

  • 🎌 Festival Atmosphere
    Experience the charm of Kawagoe’s lantern-lit streets and matsuri vibes

  • 🎮 4 Unique Stages

    • MATSURI

    • WATER PARK

    • IMO FARM

    • KURA STREET

  • 🔥 4 Difficulty Levels per Stage
    From relaxed play to intense challenges

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

  • Quick sessions, perfect for casual play

  • Satisfying “hit” feeling

  • Easy to pick up, addictive to master

  • Great for all ages

data.short_description: Blast yokai away with just one button! A fast and satisfying one-button casual action game set in Kawagoe! Hit the yokai. Save Kawagoe. There’s only one control. Hit! Hit! Home run! Smash them out of the park! Save the souls of the cursed yokai!! Bring peace back to Kawagoe with your bat!

English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 | AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 750 Ti | AMD Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 960 | AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
